DIRECTION RULES
D01 [other, all scenes] Visual Style: Realistic Sri Lankan cinematic drama, natural lighting, authentic environments and emotionally grounded performances.
D02 [editing, all scenes] Scene Structure: Fewer, longer scenes with multiple camera shots and continuous dramatic action.
D03 [editing, scene 1] A romantic montage follows: Anudi visits Kasun after work. Kasun prepares her favourite tea. They spend time talking and laughing. Anudi helps him arrange food containers. Kasun walks with her to her car. They exchange smiles before saying goodbye.
D04 [editing, scene 1] A sequence of connected moments shows his struggle. He visits a bank and discusses a business loan. He sits with a potential investor and explains his business plan. He makes phone calls to friends asking for financial support. He reviews his business documents and calculations late at night. Each attempt ends in disappointment. The bank cannot offer the required support. The investor doesn't believe the small business can handle such a large order. His friends are unable to help.
D05 [sound, scene 3] Silence.

138: SCENE 04 — KASUN'S DETERMINATION AND THE BIG OPPORTUNITY
139: Location: Kasun's small food preparation workspace
140: Duration: 1 minute
141: Late at night.
142: Kasun is working in his small rented workspace.
143: The room contains stainless-steel cooking equipment, food containers, business receipts and
144: a small table.
145: He checks his orders, calculates expenses and writes figures in a notebook.
146: His business has started growing. He is now supplying food to three small shops.
147: Anudi arrives and notices how tired he looks.
148: She looks around the workspace.
149: Anudi: "ඇයි ඔයා මේ තරම් මහන්සි වෙන්නේ?"
150: Kasun looks at her.
151: Kasun: "මට ඔයාගේ පවුලෙන් කවදාවත් ඔයාට මම ගැළපෙන්නේ නෑ කියලා අහන්න ඕනේ
152: නෑ."
153: Anudi gently holds his hand.
154: Anudi: "මට ඔයාගේ සල්ලි ඕනේ නෑ කසුන්. මට ඔයාවයි ඕනේ."
155: Kasun smiles.
156: Kasun: "ඒත් මට ඕනේ ඔයාට හොඳ අනාගතයක් දෙන්න."
157: Suddenly, Kasun's phone rings.
158: He checks the number and answers.
159: Kasun: "හෙලෝ, කසුන් කතා කරන්නේ."
160: A representative from a major supermarket chain is on the other end.
161: Representative (over the phone): "ඔයාලගේ food products අපේ branches කිහිපයකට
162: supply කරන්න අපි කැමතියි. ඒ ගැන කතා කරන්න පුළුවන්ද?"
163: Kasun is surprised.
164: Kasun: "ඇත්තටම සර්? ඒක ලොකු අවස්ථාවක්."
165: The call ends.
166: Anudi looks excited.
167: Anudi: "මොකද වුණේ?"
168: Kasun smiles.
169: Kasun: "අනුදි... අපිට ලොකු order එකක් ලැබෙන්න යන්නේ."
170: He looks at her with excitement.
171: But as he returns to his notebook and calculates the expansion costs, his expression slowly
172: changes.
173: The supermarket order requires a major investment.
174: He needs Rs. 2 million.
175: He looks at the numbers again.
176: He doesn't have enough money.
177: Anudi notices his silence.
